title: The Young Bunch: Youth Minimum Wages and Labor Market Outcomes
text: The Young Bunch: Youth Minimum Wages and Labor Market Outcomes. The authors estimate the effects of an increase in the youth minimum wage in the Netherlands on low-paid workers' employment and earnings, using a difference-in-differences approach with detailed administrative data. title: NEW ANALYSIS: High Teen Unemployment Tied to State Wage Hikes
text: NEW ANALYSIS: High Teen Unemployment Tied to State Wage Hikes. The first week of July marks the height of summer, and it also brings a wave of minimum wage increases at the state and local level. For teenagers hoping to earn extra money before the school year begins, higher wages might seem appetizing.
